mainEntity.name: Which Fiverr alternative has the lowest freelancer commission?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contra advertises commission-free freelancer payments, but free-plan client platform fees and payment processor charges can still apply. Compare the complete fee path, not just the freelancer commission.

Upwork is a closer fit for proposals, hourly contracts and ongoing projects. Fiverr is simpler when the service can be purchased as a clearly scoped Gig. The better choice depends on the project and how each side pays.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Fiverr reviews to another platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: No official bulk migration route for Fiverr reviews or seller levels was found in the sources checked on October 31, 2026. Keep permitted records and build a new profile using the destination platform's own rules.

Creating a basic Gig can start without a monthly marketplace subscription, but sellers keep 80% of the purchase amount and buyers may pay service fees. Optional seller programs, payout methods and taxes can add cost.

mainEntity.name: Which alternative is best for design contests?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freelancer.com offers contests across several categories, while 99designs focuses on design and branding. Compare the brief format, contest rules, rights and refund terms before funding a project.
